title: Reviewing Supplier Ledgers & Recording Payment Vouchers

intro.title: Supplier Ledgers & Payments
intro.subtitle: Track distributor closing balances, bill-by-bill settlements, NEFT/UPI bank references, and cash vouchers

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 5, Part 7: Reviewing Supplier Ledgers and Recording Payment Vouchers. Maintaining transparent vendor accounts prevents disputed dues and guarantees uninterrupted distributor credit.
Open a supplier profile. The ledger dashboard summarizes total purchases, returns, previous payments, and the real-time closing payable balance.
Click Record Payment. The payment portal displays outstanding invoices with options to clear specific bills or settle a partial lump sum.
Select your payment method: Bank Transfer NEFT, UPI, or Cheque. Enter the bank UTR transaction reference and payment date.
Save the payment voucher. The supplier's outstanding ledger balance reduces immediately, generating an audited cash book entry. This concludes Phase 5!

outro.takeaway: Supplier Ledgers & Payments: Track real-time distributor payables, record bank and UPI payments with UTR references, and keep supplier accounts reconciled.
